title: 🌍 Climate Intelligence for Business Central: Transforming Weather Data into Sustainable Decisions 🚀
summary: A developer demonstrates integrating OpenWeatherMap API with Business Central to optimize logistics and sustainability by analyzing weather data and carbon impacts. The two-module solution helps logistics teams anticipate weather risks, optimize shipping routes, and reduce emissions through AI-powered climate analysis and recommendations.
key_points: Uses OpenWeatherMap APIs to map addresses to GPS coordinates and retrieve real-time weather data stored in Business Central tables
Integrates OpenWeatherMap AI Assistant API for natural language queries to make intelligent, context-aware logistics decisions
Analyzes orders over 90-day periods calculating estimated CO2 impact, weather-adjusted CO2, CO2 savings potential, and climate risk scores (0-100)
Provides sustainability scoring (A+ to D grades) and dynamic filtering by risk level or optimization opportunities
Demonstrates real business cases: optimal delivery days, natural cooling system viability, and concrete pouring weather suitability

quotes.text: This contextual analysis capability enables logistics teams to make informed decisions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how AI analysis of weather data empowers better decision-making in logistics operations

quotes.text: This solution attempts to demonstrate how applied artificial intelligence can generate measurable business value through savings in reshipments and damage from adverse weather conditions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the concrete ROI potential of integrating climate data with business processes
